ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left figure is a pie chart of the proportion of global output of a certain crop accounted for by three countries. The figure labels the United States as 42%, China as 17%, Brazil as 5%, and others as 36%. The right figure is a map of China, marked with four regions Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding, among which Yi is located in northeastern China. Then reason: The United States, China, and Brazil are all important producing countries in the world, and the United States accounts for the highest proportion; this output structure conforms to the world production pattern of corn. The main producing areas of corn in China are concentrated in the Northeast region, so it corresponds to region Yi located in the northeast in the right figure.
